name: HiveMind
notes: Keeps listening with the screen off or the phone in your pocket (it shows "HiveMind is listening").
Tap words in a recording to see the phone's other guesses, and pick the right one to fix the notes.
Settings › My words: words the phone keeps getting wrong, fixed as you talk. Picking a guess can add one.
Share a recording, and Settings › Recordings shows the space they use and clears old ones.
An earpiece's button pauses and resumes (twice quickly in hands-free for "next box").
